name: The Elite of the Elite
summary: A supplier near the coast asks you to find a missing force of Kor’kron elites. Their trail points toward Alcaz Island, where something may have gone wrong.

sections.title: A Troubled Trail
sections.body: A few days ago, Kor’kron soldiers stopped here to buy supplies and rest before moving on. The supplier heard one of them speak of an island, and Alcaz lies just off the coast. Now you are asked to find the missing elites and learn what befell them.

faq.answer: They are a small force of Kor’kron soldiers who stopped here for supplies and rest before moving on.

faq.q: Where might the Kor’kron have gone?
faq.answer: One of the soldiers mentioned an island, and the supplier suspects Alcaz Island off the coast.
The Kor’kron moved on after resting, but the supplier feels something went wrong.
The supplier describes Alcaz as a really nasty place.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you are being asked to find a missing force of Kor’kron soldiers.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Elite of the Elite
